title: CNC Machine Operator
experience: Experience in the operation of CNC machines
description_text:
Only candidates already residing in Malta will be considered for this role. 
 Our esteemed client, a trailblazer in air - insulated Medium voltage switchgear, Compact and Mobile substations, Control panels, Low Voltage distribution boards, Automatic Transfer Switches, and Automatic Voltage Regulators, is actively seeking to recruit CNC Machine Operators. 🛠️ 
 The selected candidates will be responsible for the operation and programming of CNC machinery including lathes and milling machines. 
 Responsibilities 
 Operate CNC machines as per procedures and instructions. 
 Measure and inspect components to the relevant drawings. 
 Maintain a clean and organized working environment. 
 Requirements: 
 Experience in the operation of CNC machines. 
 Experience with CAD/CAM software and systems. 
 Diligent, self-motivated and with good attention to detail. 
 Experience on Fanuc controllers will be considered an asset. Training will be provided. 
 We offer 
 A welcoming and inclusive environment. 
 A state-of-the-art working facility. 
 Health insurance. 
 Health surveillance check-ups. 
 We will invest in your personal development. 
 Embark on a journey of growth and innovation with us! Your skills and dedication will be valued as we strive for excellence in our industry. 🚀
